beats.title: Aftermath on the Canyon Rim
beats.boundaryReason: The party recovers, binds the captive, discusses Delwath’s armor, and searches the dead before descending.
dateEvidence: Opening follows the previous battle; session drStart is May 5; sunset approaches at u0324.

beats.title: Havdar’s Losses and the Ambush
beats.boundaryReason: Descending into camp starts a distinct debrief with Havdar and Aram; the captive is revived next.
dateEvidence: Same evening; u0324–u0328 explicitly place sunset and the impending funeral before the interrogation.

beats.title: The Blighted One’s Promises
beats.boundaryReason: Aram revives the captive; first interrogation establishes Grash, Uzgash’s people, and the resurrection claim before the party withdraws to confer.
dateEvidence: Continues directly from the sunset debrief; u0425–u0430 initiate burning the bodies.

beats.title: The Gods’ Silence
beats.boundaryReason: The party switches to a private Dunmari discussion of the gods, planar travel, and their purpose before returning to the captive.
dateEvidence: An uninterrupted sidebar during the evening interrogation; no rest or travel.

beats.title: Gorkil’s Command and Its Aftermath
beats.boundaryReason: Questioning resumes, Gorkil compels Seeker to kill him, and the party reports to Havdar and considers possible peaceful orc settlements.
dateEvidence: u0785 explicitly says the sun is beginning to set; the funeral follows at u1060.

beats.title: Funeral, Gifts, and Arrow Practice
beats.boundaryReason: Havdar invites the party to the funeral, gives and trades magic items, and joins the evening meal; practice and overnight rest close the day.
dateEvidence: u1085 places the funeral at sunset, u1188–u1192 describe nighttime practice, and u1247–u1250 describe dinner and a quiet night.

beats.title: Scouts Return; The Monastery Beckons
beats.boundaryReason: The next morning’s scouts report and the party chooses its destination and initial pace.
dateEvidence: u1252 explicitly opens the next morning after the May 5 overnight rest; scouts return midmorning at u1258.

beats.title: South Through the Desert
beats.boundaryReason: Farewells lead into the multi-day southern detour, ongoing training, and the transition into barren desert; the fifth travel day begins next.
dateEvidence: u1394 departure after the hottest part of the day; u1469 covers departure afternoon plus the next two days (May 6–8), then u1480 advances another day (May 9).

beats.title: Camp by the Dry Kharja
beats.boundaryReason: The fifth travel day turns east and ends with a river camp; the party considers southern trees but chooses to continue toward the monastery.
dateEvidence: u1486–u1488 explicitly say fifth day including departure and morning; u1509–u1512 mark late day; u1552 returns to the same setting sun after discussing the next day.

beats.title: Northward to the Kharsan Overlook
beats.boundaryReason: The next morning’s travel reaches a distant view of Kharsan, its tombs and fort; Wellby attracts a hawk and begins Beast Sense.
dateEvidence: u1566 explicitly says next morning; u1572 late morning, u1577 three or four in the afternoon, and u1631 four in the afternoon.

beats.title: A Hawk’s View of Kharsan
beats.boundaryReason: The aerial survey maps the city, tombs, fort, and monastery and identifies a sheltered approach; the session closes without entering the site.
dateEvidence: Continuous Beast Sense reconnaissance after the four-in-the-afternoon anchor at u1631; no further overnight transition.
